text: Jemma Quikswitch is a gnome engineer located in the shop Springspindle's Gadgets in Tinker Town in Ironforge.

Jandi is a jungle troll artisan herbalism trainer located in Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, Jandi resided in the Drag. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Zeal'aya.
__NOTOC__ Jannok Breezesong is a night elf rogue trainer located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Jeffrey Kaplan (alias Tigole) is a former Lead Game Designer at Blizzard Entertainment, formerly responsible for world design of World of Warcraft (and subsequent expansions), including "quests, outdoor zones, dungeons, raids etc." He was the lead designer for Overwatch. He was a part of Team 4. On April 20, 2021, it was announced that Kaplan was leaving the company and Aaron Keller would be his successor as Game Director for Overwatch.
Jeering Spectre's Essence drops from: * Eldreth Phantasm in Dire Maul * Eldreth Spectre in Dire Maul * Eldreth Spirit in Dire Maul * Eldreth Apparition in Dire Maul

The Jansen Stead is the northernmost farm in Westfall, and is located near the bridge to Elwynn Forest. Like most of the farms in Westfall, the owners have been driven off by the Defias Brotherhood. The farm is occupied by a large amount of Homeless Stormwind Citizens, West Plains Drifters and Transients. The Jansen Stead is currently under investigation following the murder of Theodore and Verna Furlbrow nearby, but no one seems to want to reveal any details about their murder. This investigation eventually leads to the Furlbrows' nearby farm. Private Jansen of the Westfall Brigade is most likely connected to the farmstead.

Je'neu Sancrea is a jungle troll quest giver and a member of the Earthen Ring found in Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale before the Cataclysm. After the Cataclysm, he was found just inside Blackfathom Deeps. In the events of invasion of Draenor, he and Zeya were captured by the Twilight's Hammer and barely escaped before they could be sacrificed to Aku'mai.
Javnir Nashak is an orc quest giver and vendor that appears just south of Orgrimmar in Durotar during the Harvest Festival. He also sends a letter which contains Bounty of the Harvest.
Jason Lemieux is a Forsaken fungus vendor located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.
Jawn Highmesa is a tauren located in Camp Mojache in Feralas. Before the Cataclysm, he was located at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles acting as a general goods vendor.
__NOTOC__ Jannos Ironwill is a dwarf mace vendor located in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

Jazzrik is a goblin blacksmithing vendor located in a small camp in the Valley of Fangs in Badlands. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. It seems likely he was killed when Deathwing made the Scar of the Worldbreaker, which blasted clean through Rigglefuzz's camp. This may also explain why their former companion Martek the Exiled now seems prone to drinking heavily and harboring a deep hatred toward Deathwing.

Jediga is an orc quest giver located at Valormok in Azshara. She was sent to Azshara by Belgrom Rockmaul as punishment for rejecting his offers. She enjoys a good ale and wishes to get out of Azshara as soon as possible.

__NOTOC__ Jarquia is a murloc found in the Misty Reed Strand within the Swamp of Sorrows. Krinkle Goodsteel wants his flamberge back from Jarquia. Jarquia has a very fast respawn rate. Just wait about a minute and he should be back.
Jannos Lighthoof is a tauren druid trainer located in Camp Mojache in Feralas. You can only train from this trainer, not respec.
Jangdor Swiftstrider is a tauren leatherworking vendor located at Stonemaul Hold in Feralas. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in Camp Mojache.
__NOTOC__ Jel is a draenei cloth and leather armor vendor located at the Crash Site in Azuremyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Jelena Nightsky is a night elf master skinning trainer located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. She can be found in the main room, downstairs, in the inn.
Jang'thraze the Protector drops from Chief Ukorz Sandscalp in Zul'Farrak.
__NOTOC__ Jane is a blood elf child located north of the Sunspire. She is on the beach with her dad, Jessel, her sister, Nova, and her cat, Kitty.
Jazdalaad is an ethereal master jewelcrafting trainer located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.
Jarkal's Enhancing Necklace is a quest reward from Necklace Recovery, Take 3.

Jangdor's Handcrafted Boots are a quest reward from The Mark of Quality (Horde).
Jangdor's Handcrafted Tunic is a quest reward from Improved Quality (Horde).

Jaramin Skisson was a tutor to Taretha Foxton and Thrall. He is described as a "fussy, kind man". Jaramin taught Thrall how to read and write and was impressed at his intelligence. He was surprised when Aedelas Blackmoore told him that they would no longer need his services. He protested that Thrall knew little of subjects such as history or art, but Blackmoore dismissed his concerns, telling him that he only allowed Thrall to learn how to read because he thought it would make him a better strategist. His status is unknown.

Jaxxil Sparks is a Holiday Fireworks Vendor. He sells fireworks during the Midsummer Fire Festival or Peon Day seasonal events (see Notes section.) He can be found inside the Inn at neutral port of Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
__NOTOC__ Janice's Parcel is provided as an objective for the following quests: * Better Late Than Never (Alliance) * Better Late Than Never (Horde) * Good Natured Emma * The Jeremiah Blues
Jannok's Rose was provided as an objective for The Apple Falls.
Janeda's Restorative Draught is provided as an objective for Captives at Deatholme.
Jaron's Pick is provided as an objective for Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril.
Jaz is a level 52 prisoner inside the Halls of the Law of Blackrock Depths. He shares the cell with Ograbisi.
__NOTOC__ Jarold Puller is a human located inside the Hunter's Reach in Dalaran. He was present during the purge of Dalaran.
Jedoga Shadowseeker is the third boss found in Ahn'kahet. She is a female orc and leader to the Twilight's Hammer and a servant of Yogg-Saron, an Old God.
Elder Jarten is located in an alcove just past the Prince Keleseth's room, and before the staircase up. Just turn around to the left when you approach the landing before you go up the stairs.

__NOTOC__ Jayde is a highly-skilled Darkfallen death knight of the Knights of the Ebon Blade. Though she was expected to decimate the Argent Dawn forces at the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel, she was instead freed from the Lich King's control by Highlord Tirion Fordring. She aids players against High Priest Yath'amon during the quest The Air Stands Still.
Jamesina Watterly is a forsaken grand master engineering trainer at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord. See Howling Fjord NPCs.

Jason Morris is a Forsaken located in the docked ship at Vengeance Landing along with his family Julian, Nicole, and Jessica.

.]] Jeeves is a repair bot item crafted by engineers. Jeeves is the first Repair bot that is not 'consumed' on use, although requiring a large amount of resources to craft. It is also the first bot to provide bank access, although only to Engineers.
This item is a reward from the quest The Air Stands Still. They belonged to Jayde.

Jarim Balnir was the son of the horsebreeder Jorum Balnir and his wife Vara, and a childhood friend of Prince Arthas Menethil. He was the same age as Arthas. Neither of the boys cared that a horsebreeder's son wasn't a proper companion for a prince, and their parents didn't try to stop the friendship. One winter day when Jarim and Arthas were throwing snowballs and playing Guards and Bandits, Jorum invited the boys to assist the horse Brightmane as she gave birth to her son Invincible, who later became Arthas' own steed. During the winter storm that led to the death of Invincible, it was Jarim and his father who found Arthas and rescued the prince from freezing to death in the woods near the

Janks is Jeer Sparksocket's assistant. He is currently trapped in the Sparksocket Minefield in the Storm Peaks (Jeer having forgotten to tell him the escape route, after they completed it).

Jangdor's Letter is provided as an objective for Master of the Wild Leather (Horde).

James Waugh was the Director of Story and Creative Development at Blizzard Entertainment. He served as a script consultant, editor and IP developer for Blizzard's narrative properties, also contributing to game content and world building. Waugh co-wrote the Curse of the Worgen miniseries for Wildstorm Comics. He was also the writer behind the short story Lord of His Pack and animated series Harbingers. He bid his farewell to Blizzard on September 16, 2016.

Jaws of Defeat drops from Majordomo Staghelm in the Firelands.
Jeklik's Smasher drops from Jin'do the Godbreaker in Zul'Gurub.
Jarund Stoutstrider is tauren located at Valor's Rest in Silithus.

Jeb Guthrie is one of the hunters and cooks at Goodgrub Smoking Pit. He is seen arguing with over which is better: owl meat or bear meat. He prefers the owl meat.
Je'Tze's Sparkling Tiara is a random world drop from Cataclysm mobs.
Jarygos is the late mate of Kirygosa. It is implied that her grief for him made her more susceptible to Arygos' betrayal. His children were used by the Twilight's Hammer for chromatic experiments.

Jellix Fuselighter is a goblin quest giver located at the Northern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara. He needs his workers back.

Janae is a pandaren found in Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds. She can be seen walking with Danae. The pair stroll through Halfhill, sometimes going to look out over the Gilded Fan.

Jaxx the Rabid is a rare hyena found sleeping in the hills to the west of Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

Jehil the Climber is found at atop Grombolash's skeleton in Colossal's Fall in Frostfire Ridge. To get to him, run up to Sky-Singer Strag's platform and turn around, jumping off the platform to the bones to the northwest. Run up the backbone, jumping on to the leather tarp, then jump back to get on to the first rib. Jump over the first rope, then before trying to jump over the second, turn left to find Jehil asleep on the shoulder bone, so jump over to him.
Jenaa is a draenei found in the upper level of in southern Talador, defending a dozen draenei children from Lo'marg Jawcrusher. Aggro Lo'marg: : Finish him off: :

Jared V. Hellstrike is a Forsaken monk captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Hellstrike or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Jaspertip Borers are rock flayers found in western Deepholm.

Jelky was a goblin on Kezan who lived at Copper Street in Bilgewater Port, and a childhood friend of Jastor Gallywix. He would spend all day braiding fuses. It's unknown what happened to him or if he survived the destruction of Kezan.

Jason De Arte was a Blizzard Entertainment employee and software engineer on World of Warcraft as of September 2014, working with servers, tools, SQL and automation, among other things. By April 2016 he had left the company.
in 2016]] Jared Gillis is a server engineer on World of Warcraft.

Jason Chayes is the former project director of Hearthstone. He was recruited by Blizzard Entertainment specifically for the project. It was confirmed on October 28, 2019 that Jason Chayes had left Blizzard Entertainment.

Jay Wilson was a game director at Blizzard Entertainment from 2006 until 2016. After 10 and a half years with the company, in June 2016 he left Blizzard and the games industry to return to his original passion, writing. After originally being recruited to work on Starcraft II, Wilson worked on a number of projects including World of Warcraft, and went on to become lead director on Diablo III. In 2013 he stepped down from Diablo III to work on other Blizzard projects.
Jena is a jungle troll found in the Brokenspear Tavern in Warspear. She is sitting with Col'in and next to her is Spears. She later appeared in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
James McCoy is a Forsaken found in Warspear, Ashran. He is located outside the Tower of Elements, next to Kas Felbinder.

Jed'hin was a sport practiced by the eredar, a tradition lost during the draenei's long journey. Grand Artificer Romuul describes it as "ritual combat" and "the old ways." Echoes of the citizens of Eredath on Argus can be found still playing the game. One needed not worry about competitors' heads, as only males with the thickest crests chose to compete. It seems to be an ancient sport, as it was described as a "basic ritual" and Councilor Othaar liked to think that it showed how far the eredar had come. At the Circle of Aspirants in Eredath, players can challenge each other in jed'hin by using the Jed'hin Master "vehicles".
Jeff Liu is a Senior User Interface Designer on World of Warcraft at Blizzard Entertainment.

Jed'hin Adepts are eredar located at the Circle of Aspirants in Eredath.

Jane Cogputter is a gnome located outside Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn cheering at the participants of the Great Gnomeregan Run.

James Ryman is a TCG artist. He began working with Blizzard in 2008, illustrating for Servants of the Betrayer; he now does Hearthstone card art.

Jamil Abul'housin is a Zandalari troll located in the Hall of Chroniclers in the Great Seal and later in Zuldazar. He attended the funeral of King Rastakhan. Later, he was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.
Jegwa the Shaggy is a troll located at the Hide or Hair shop in the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor. Katnis Sniptip gives them a trim.

Jawstretcher was a gnoll of the Woodpaw clan. He had a son named Hackle. He agreed with Matriarch Greasefang about the Feral Scar yetis being the cause of the problems with trees. Following Claw's death, he became the clan's brute. The Gordunni ogres attacked the Woodpaw lands and the gnolls fought back. When Matriarch Gnaw ordered the Woodpaws to move east and later to south, Jawstretcher agreed. Eventually, the ogres found them again and Jawstretcher was killed by Wordok. Jawstretcher was ultimately avenged when Hackle killed Wordok in Dire Maul.

Jeff Strain was the lead programmer at Blizzard Entertainment. He previously worked on World of Warcraft, created the StarCraft campaign editor, and worked on Diablo and Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. He left Blizzard in 2000 and founded with Mike O'Brien and Patrick Wyatt.

Jani is a saurid loa known as the Patron of Scavengers, the Lord of Thieves, the God of Garbage, Master of Minions, the Keeper of Secrets, Ruler of Rubbish, Master of all things Discarded an' Unwanted, and the loa of discarded things. Jani looks out for the people that others might be throwing away or ignoring, such as the orphans and the poor. He can be found by interacting with the Mysterious Trashpiles all over Zandalar. Jani appears to be very protective of his children, as well as being quite the trickster, polymorphing those that hurt his children to humble them while laughing at their expense. Jellyfish are aquatic and transparent beasts that acts as a decorative NPC, they have a luminescent cap and potentially-poisonous tentacles. Most of them are located in deep sea caverns such as Dive Bar and Heyman's Hideaway. The jellyfish had been released in the Legion expansion pack as mounts and as mobs, and as companion pets in Battle for Azeroth. They are smaller and friendlier than helsquid.
Jen the Fixer is a human located in Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound.

Jeff Grubb is the author of The Last Guardian, and a co-author of the Warcraft: The Roleplaying Game. Grubb played World of Warcraft heavily for a while, then quit, then came back with a group of friends in 2008, then quit again. The friends he played with would usually either outlevel him or quit the game, leaving Grubb's character an orphan. As a result, he had characters scattered around a half-dozen realms and never got to end-game content. While Grubb has not authored any Warcraft novels since The Last Guardian, in 2008 he stated that he was open to the possibility of writing for Blizzard again should the opportunity present itself.

Jason Hayes is a Senior Composer for Blizzard Entertainment and was Lead Composer of the original release of World of Warcraft. He left Blizzard suddenly when World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King came out for unknown reasons, but returned with World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria in Patch 5.1. Hayes has also worked on the StarCraft and Diablo franchise and Warcraft III, as well as Hearthstone. Derek Duke, Glenn Stafford and him were the original music team for StarCraft.

Jewelcrafting recipes, called designs, are used by jewelcrafters in order to create rings, necklaces, trinkets, and also cut gems which can be set into sockets on armor and weapons. Many designs are taught by Jewelcrafting trainers, while other patterns may be purchased from a vendor, obtained as loot, or given as a reward for completing a Jewelcrafting quest. The acquisition of some patterns requires a level of reputation with certain factions, which can be viewed in the Jewelcrafting faction recipes table. Ingredients are used in Jewelcrafting designs to create items. Some Jewelcrafting recipes require ingredients that are crafted or gathered by various professions, found as loot or purchased from vendors. The vast majority of Jewelcrafting ingredients can be gathered with Mining, produced by Prospecting or found as loot. Very few jewelcrafting products can be used themselves as ingredients for other professions.
